description.value: Thor's Pizzeria is a Nelson institution that bills itself as the city's healthiest pizza, with a broad Greek and Norse mythology-themed menu spanning specialty meat pies, six dedicated vegetarian options, and pizza by the slice. Cyclists will find a full dine-in room, takeout, and delivery all under one roof on Victoria Street in the heart of Nelson. The playful menu branding and wide vegetarian selection make it a practical and memorable refuelling stop on a BC touring route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active business at http://thorspizza.ca with phone 250-352-1212 and explicit service modes of 'Take-out | Eat-In | Delivery | Pizza By-the-Slice'. OSM diet:vegetarian=yes is corroborated by a dedicated 'Veggie Pizzas' section listing six options on the website, while OSM diet:vegan=no aligns with the absence of any vegan labeling. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and Wi-Fi (despite OSM internet_access=wlan) are not mentioned anywhere on the website and cannot be confirmed.
